garmin - fenix 9 pro - inreach amoled gp.description: The premium fēnix 9 Pro multisport GPS smartwatch offers serious athletes and outdoor adventurers the ultimate in performance, connectivity and style. Its 1.5" AMOLED display is the largest of any fēnix smartwatch ever. Plus, it introduces the first-ever titanium fēnix watch case for lightweight comfort and lasting durability. Other highlights include a scratch-resistant sapphire lens and powerful LED flashlight with white, red or green light settings. The watch’s built-in inReach connectivity lets you leave your phone behind and still call, text or share your LiveTrack™ location from your wrist with an LTE connection — or use a satellite link for off-grid messaging (active plan required; satellite connection, SOS functionality and coverage limitations apply, making them unavailable in certain situations; some jurisdictions regulate or prohibit the use of satellite communication devices). You also get free emergency SOS messaging for up to 12 months after the free trial period. The latest Garmin stamina and endurance tracking features, including stamina curve and stamina zones, help you visualize how far, how fast and how long you can go based on your fitness gains and training history. And with 100+ activity profiles — including enhancements to rowing and rucking — you’ll discover new ways to push your limits. There’s also a Garmin Epic feature that lets you record and share multiple days of activities, along with health and performance stats, as a cohesive storyline. Explore with preloaded multicontinent TopoActive maps that are routable, smoother and more intuitive than ever — adding confidence to your navigation, even if you change course along the way. Count on up to 31 days of battery life in smartwatch mode to keep the adventure going.
